title: Azure DevOps Personal access token: one-property twin (length)
summary: 3 inputs are identical to a positive input except for one change: the value's length differs from the contracted length. Legacy mutation notes: length: 83 vs provider-documented 84 characters; AZDO signature position unchanged. Twin of "Azure DevOps Personal access token: must be flagged".
rationale: A twin changes exactly one property, so the expected outcome differs from the positive for that one reason. Reporting the twin is a false alarm, and it shows that the changed property is part of what identifies the credential.
